slices.focus: Colleen pays out of pocket for heavy shelving to turn her cluttered dining room into a functional home prep zone.
slices.summary: Tripping over outreach bins one morning pushes Colleen to invest in proper shelving for her dining room, which had become a chaotic museum supply spill. She creates labeled zones (lesson tubs, handouts, spare pieces), establishes a table rule (nothing lives there unless actively packing), and plans a designated outbound launch spot. The expense tightens her budget short-term but reduces daily friction. The deeper meaning: admitting the workload is not temporary, so the home setup must match reality.
open_loops: Labels: big, plain, categorical -- not pretty, just obvious
Launch spot by door for outbound-only staging
Monthly 20-minute reset for maintenance (not weekly punishment)
